remote.description: Remote KB server URL, http(s) only (required when provider=http). Use https for any non-loopback host: plain http sends the token in cleartext.

token.description: Authentication token for remote KB server. Either a literal token (stored encrypted, never logged) or exactly one named fleet secret placeholder of the form {{secret.NAME}} with nothing around it: then only the placeholder is stored and the server looks the secret up on each request, so rotating the secret needs no kb_setup re-run. For provider http the secret must already exist (apra-fleet secret --set NAME --persist -y).

request_timeout_ms.description: Socket idle timeout in milliseconds for each request to the remote KB server, 1000-120000 (default 5000). Not a per-request deadline: a call can wait up to about twice this while queued offline writes flush first.

tool_profile.description: Install-wide KB tool profile for interactive (non-member) sessions: full (every kb_* tool, the default), developer (kb_session_prime, kb_query, kb_context, kb_capture, kb_feedback) or custom (the kb_* names in tool_profile_tools). Member sessions and sprint roles are unaffected. Takes effect when a session reconnects. A usability control, not a security boundary; developer hides kb_setup, so switch back with the CLI: apra-fleet kb profile full. Can be set alone, without provider/remote/token.

tool_profile_tools.description: The registered kb_* tool names the custom tool_profile serves (required with tool_profile custom, not allowed otherwise). An unknown name is refused and nothing is written.

embedding_model.description: Embedding model for KB semantic search: "none" (semantic search off; keyword and anchor search keep serving), a built-in model name (bge-small-en-v1.5, snowflake-arctic-embed-s, snowflake-arctic-embed-xs), or a custom-model object ({id, revision} for a Hugging Face model pinned to a full commit sha, or {path} for a local folder; optional pooling, normalize, query_prefix, doc_prefix, dtype, dims, token_limit, semantic_floor). Takes effect on the running server at once, no restart. A malformed value is refused and nothing is written. Can be set alone, without provider/remote/token.

repo_path.description: REMOVED -- do not pass. A call carrying it fails with E-SCOPE-KEY-REMOVED; the KB is always the calling session's own.
